verdict.rationale: Brex documents many APIs (Accounting, Budgets, Payments, Transactions, Webhooks and others), but nothing in the evidence mentions API versioning, version identifiers, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The axis applies to a SaaS with a public developer API, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
